_comment: Shared chat-parameter contract pinned by both pytest and vitest so the backend ChatParameters model and the frontend parameter panel cannot drift. A key present on one side only is silently dropped by the other — Pydantic ignores unknown keys, and the panel renders only keys it knows — so the loss is invisible without this pin.
_capability_comment: Rendered as controls like a knob, but each is a capability claim the provider states per model rather than a value the wire format accepts.
_passthrough_comment: Bypasses supported-parameter filtering by design and merges into the provider body last — the escape hatch when a capability source is wrong.
_reasoning_comment: Every effort level any provider accepts. Which levels a given model takes is published per model in ChatCapabilities.reasoning_efforts; this is only the gate against nonsense.
_styles_comment: ReasoningStyle — how a provider is asked to let a model reason.
_sampling_comment: SamplingSupport — when a model accepts temperature/top_p/top_logprobs. Measured per model at bundle generation, never inferred from a version: gpt-5.4 accepts temperature where gpt-5.5 needs reasoning off, and gpt-5 never accepts it.
